entries.en:
You have been invited to take part in the Iron Culinarian Challenge as part of the Moonfire Faire festivities. Procure yourself some freshly caught haddock, batter and fry it to a crisp golden brown, and deliver your culinary masterpiece back to Hildelana, who will see that it finds a proper home in the belly of a peckish faire-goer.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

Cette quête ne peut être commencée et effectuée que pendant la durée de l'événement saisonnier correspondant. Pour plus de détails, veuillez consulter The Lodestone.

Hildelana vous a expliqué comment se déroule le concours de cuisine des Feux de la Mort: vous devez préparer et lui remettre. Si vous avez besoin de l'ingrédient principal qu'est , vous pouvez en obtenir auprès du pêcheur souriant tout près d'elle ou en attraper au nord de l'île de l'Éternel été.

* Vous pouvez synthétiser vous-même en tant que cuisini ou l'acheter aux marchés.

entries.en: You put your culinary skills to good use in preparing a prime piece of battered fish boasting flavor and texture fit for a king, and deliver it to Hildelana, who is duly impressed. She rewards your surpassing skill with a skillet with a single Faire voucher, and invites you to return to participate in the challenge again should you so desire.

entries.en: Greetings, my gourmet-inclined friend! Since you've stepped up to speak to me, I presume that you're looking to take part in the one and only Iron Culinarian Challenge? Oh, happy day!
entries.fr: Vous êtes venu<if(gnum4,e,)> participer aux attractions des Feux de la Mort<nbsp>? Un grand merci<nbsp>! Comme vous le savez peut-être, nous organisons cette année un concours de cuisine pour permettre aux aventuriers de démontrer leurs talents d'artisans<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
紅蓮祭へのご参加、誠にありがとうございます！
ここでは、冒険者の製作技能をアピールするために、
「調理大会」を開催しております。

entries.en: Don't fret if this is your first time, for the rules of the challenge are simple enough. First, I will prescribe for you a particular dish. Next, you'll procure the necessary ingredients and get cooking. Finally, you'll bring your creation back to me for inspection. If your culinary creation is up to snuff, you'll win yourself a Faire voucher for your efforts!

entries.en: But I jest. You may rest assured that your most mouthwatering creation will find a good home in the tummy of one of your fellow festival-goers. Take this Faire voucher as your reward, and take pride in a job well done. Farewell, and should you ever be so inclined as to show off your skills with a skillet once more, you know where to find me!
